program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to repaired multi-step relation chain
question: Can the attributed low-support transition errors be reduced with one fixed training-only pooled backoff that reuses the existing relation tables and adds no learned capacity?
hypothesis: For exact-pair contexts with training support below 3, replace the sealed current-row-only fallback with an equal-probability mixture of the normalized current-motif successor row and the normalized existing overflow exact-pair successor row. Leave all support-at-least-3 behavior byte-identical to the sealed baseline. At runtime pair-state cap 2048, the repair will improve depth-3 low-support top-1 accuracy by at least 0.01 and pooled depth-3 top-1 accuracy by at least 0.005 while depth-2 pooled accuracy degrades by no more than 0.005 and no source degrades by more than 0.01.

prior_evidence.diagnosis: Training exact-pair support below 3 is the strongest frozen depth-3 transition-error concentration and is therefore the bounded repair target.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.exact_pair_relation: byte-identical top-511 exact-pair successor rows plus one overflow row

repair.target: only heldout/runtime states whose training exact-pair support is below 3
repair.combination: 0.5 * current_distribution + 0.5 * pooled_low_support_distribution when both are nonempty; otherwise use the nonempty distribution

controls.baseline: sealed context-transition attribution predictor with identical cap 2048 and no low-support pooled repair
controls.paired_queries: repair and baseline score identical untouched suffix queries

classification_rules.supported: Validity passes and all frozen low-support, pooled depth-3, depth-2 nondegradation, and per-source nondegradation thresholds pass.
classification_rules.mixed: Validity passes and low-support depth-3 accuracy improves, but at least one pooled or nondegradation threshold fails.
classification_rules.negative: Validity passes but low-support depth-3 accuracy does not improve over the sealed baseline.
classification_rules.invalid: Any sealed-parent, authority, source, split, representation, repair-target, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation criterion fails.

validity_criteria: Exact sealed attribution parent and North Star identities match.
Fresh READY_RESEARCH is bound to this exact preregistration and manifest.
Only training-prefix counts determine pair support, current rows, overflow row, ambiguity cutoff, and all repair behavior.
No new motif, relation row, counter table, context state, or runtime pair-state capacity is introduced.
Support-at-least-3 runtime states use the sealed baseline byte-for-byte.
Repair and baseline score the same heldout suffix queries at cap 2048.
Duplicate complete probes are byte-identical and all probability mass checks pass.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, support threshold, current/exact tables, overflow identity, 0.5 mixture weight, cap 2048, horizons, controls, metrics, thresholds, classification, or authority after primary output.

successor_if_supported.intent: carry the supported fixed-capacity low-support repair into the next raw-representation -> relation -> reasoning bridge without changing substrate capacity

successor_if_mixed_or_negative.intent: attribute whether the pooled overflow distribution is too heterogeneous before introducing any additional state
